title: Accounts Payable Assistant
description:
Are you a proactive and collaborative individual who is able to assist ion the smooth and efficient running of our daily Procure-to-Pay (P2 P) processes? At Movianto, UK we are looking for a Accounts Payable Assistant to join our Bedford team!

This is a 6 month fixed term contract. You will be working Monday to Friday (37.5 hours a week) on an annual salary of £26,500.00 per annum

Benefits
- No weekend or bank holiday working
- Discounted gym memberships
- 33 days annual leave (including bank holidays)
- Holiday Purchase scheme
- Flexible pay through Wagestream
- Life Assurance
- Up to 4% Employer Pension Contribution
- Access to Simply Health
- 24/7 GP, physiotherapy and counselling through our EAP service
- Cycle to Work scheme
- Access to MyRewards, a benefits platform

Purpose of the role

Ensure daily P2 P process runs smoothly, supplier invoices and credits are registered and accounts reconciled. Working collaboratively with all departments in Movianto UK to ensure its financial health, manage risks, financial analysis and developing processes to be "Best in Class" always striving for Continuous Improvement.

How you'll make an impact as a Accounts Payable Assistant at Movianto:
- Ensure all supplier's accounts are accurate and reconciled by processing invoices, credit notes and statements in a timely and accurate manner
- Opening, distribution and processing of all incoming post, email and calls
- Scanning all invoices and backing documentation into Oracle system
- Processing invoices, credit notes and adjustments using Oracle system
- Monthly reconciliation of supplier statements to ledger and ensure accurate balances are shown at all times
- Deal with supplier queries efficiently and in a professional manner
- Process Expense claims and Corporate/Travel Card claims according to the correct VAT regulations
- Work with accounting and FP&A colleagues on accruals and other queries to ensure accurate financials
- Perform additional accounts payable duties as directed

What it will take to thrive as a Accounts Payable Assistant at Movianto:
- Ensures a high degree of accuracy in all tasks
- Works closely with all colleagues to achieve finance mission of ensuring business financial health, supporting growth and adding value
- Supports an environment where the Customer comes first both externally and internally
- Complies with all standard operating procedures in place relevant to work activities
- Live the Company values through tasks and communication with internal and external stakeholders
- Experience with Oracle EBS or Oracle Cloud advantageous
- Experience of working with MS Excel for business reporting
- Ability to handle pressure and difficult suppliers with good telephone manner
- Experienced in complying with corporate finance policies
- Must have a flexible approach to work and be capable of handling multiple priorities in a fast paced environment with a 'can do, will do' approach
- Ability to work with colleagues and customers from varied backgrounds and cultures

Skills & Education:
- GCSE educated or similar level
- Very good written and oral skills in English
- High standard of interpersonal communication and convincing intercultural skills
- Ability to investigate and answer supplier queries
- Strong attention to detail with a high degree of accuracy and excellent communication skills
- Analytical mindset in approaching queries from stakeholders
- Ability to work independently, using own initiative and target orientated
- Understanding of how to build strong working relationships across business

Who we are

Movianto is a leading pharmaceutical supply chain solutions partner offering best-in-class logistics quality for the pharmaceutical, biotech, medical device and diagnostic industries.

Ready to make a difference with us? Apply now and become a part of our dedicated team!

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Bookkeeper - Luton

Cadence Search are assisting this fast paced and growing residential property development business in seeking a Book Keeper to join their ambitious team. With multiple projects and an expanding workload they are seeking an experienced, organised and proactive Bookkeeper to take ownership of our day-to-day bookkeeping and financial administration.

Working closely with the Head of Commercial, project teams and external accountants, you will maintain accurate financial records, reconcile invoices and accounts, prepare weekly payment schedules and support effective financial control across our developments.

This is a hands-on role suited to someone who understands construction accounting, follows up discrepancies and takes pride in keeping accounts accurate and up to date.

Key responsibilities

Bookkeeping and accounting systems
- Maintain accurate and current financial records using Xero and JNC.
- Record purchase invoices, sales invoices, receipts, payments and journals.
- Allocate expenditure to the correct company, development, project and cost code.
- Reconcile bank accounts, company credit cards and other control accounts.

Purchase invoices and supplier reconciliation
- Check invoices against purchase orders, delivery records, agreed rates and authorised works.
- Obtain the appropriate approval before including invoices for payment.
- Reconcile supplier statements and investigate missing invoices, duplicate charges, credit notes and other discrepancies.
- Liaise with suppliers, subcontractors and site teams to resolve queries promptly.

CIS administration and returns
- Maintain subcontractor records and coordinate CIS verification.
- Calculate and record applicable CIS deductions.
- Prepare and submit monthly CIS returns, working with the external accountant where necessary.
- Prepare and issue subcontractor payment and deduction statements.
- Reconcile CIS liabilities and prepare payments for approval.

Weekly staff and subcontractor payments
- Collate and check approved timesheets, attendance records, agreed rates and supporting information for weekly paid staff and subcontractors.
- Reconcile proposed payments against authorised hours, work completed and relevant deductions.
- Prepare weekly payment schedules and certify that the supporting records and calculations have been checked.

VAT, month-end and accountant support
- Maintain accurate VAT records and support the preparation and submission of VAT returns.
- Apply the appropriate VAT treatment, including construction domestic reverse charge where applicable, with accountant guidance.
- Complete regular month-end reconciliations and provide information for management accounts.

Cash flow and financial reporting
- Prepare weekly payment forecasts and maintain visibility of upcoming commitments.
- Monitor outstanding customer balances and follow up overdue payments.
- Provide regular summaries of bank balances, creditors, debtors and outstanding queries.

Essential experience and skills
- Proven bookkeeping experience, ideally within construction or property development.
- Practical experience of CIS administration and returns.
- Strong working knowledge of Xero.
- Experience checking weekly payroll or subcontractor payment schedules.
- Strong invoice, supplier statement and bank reconciliation skills.
- Good Excel skills and confidence working with accounting systems.

Desirable
- Experience using JNC.
- AAT qualification, bookkeeping qualification or equivalent practical experience. (Crestview are willing to fund an AAT course if the preferred candidate wishes to progress their career).

title: Credit Controller
description:
Role Purpose
- To support the timely collection of outstanding customer debts, minimise overdue balances and support the cash flow of the business. The role involves proactively managing customer accounts, resolving payment queries and maintaining accurate records, whilst building positive customer relationships and ensuring compliance with company credit control procedures.

Key Responsibilities
- Debt Collection: Proactively chase overdue balances by telephone and email, maintain accurate records of customer interactions and credit control activity on k 8, and ensure monthly statements and credit chase streams are processed promptly.
- Customer Accounts: Manage a portfolio of accounts, including key customers, encouraging timely payments in line with agree credit terms.
- Credit Management: Monitor overdue accounts, apply and release credit stops in accordance with company procedures, and review customer credit limits.
- Query Resolution: Work closely with customers, branches and sales teams to resolve invoice disputes and outstanding queries promptly.
- Debt Recovery: Identify potentially problematic debts, issue formal payment notices and escalate accounts for legal recovery where necessary.
- Account Administration: Process new credit applications, set up accounts on k 8 and CRM, and maintain accurate customer records.
- Payment Processing: Process customer card payments, authorised settlement discounts, credit adjustments and write-offs.
- Account Adjustments: Process authorised customer settlement discounts, credit notes and bad debt write-offs.
- Reporting and Housekeeping: Maintain accurate collection notes, monitor outstanding invoices and review dormant customer accounts.
- Group Support: Provide holiday cover and support consistent credit control procedures across the Group.

Skills and Experience
- Previous credit control or accounts receivable experience.
- Confident communicator with strong negotiation and customer service skills.
- Organised, proactive and able to manage competing priorities.
- Good attention to detail and ability to resolve problems efficiently.
- Competent in Microsoft Excel, Outlook and accounting systems.
- Experience of Kerridge k 8 and the construction or distribution sector would be advantageous.

Personal Attributes
- A proactive, organised and commercially aware individual with a firm but professional approach to debt collection. Able to work independently, build positive customer relationships and contribute effectively to the wider finance team.

title: Payroll Administrator
description:
Adapro Talent Partners are delighted to be exclusively partnering with a Bedfordshire based, multi-site retail business who are looking to recruit a Payroll & Expenses Administrator.

The Payroll & Expenses Administrator, will be part of a small, friendly Payroll team within the wider Finance function. They will take ownership of the end-to-end in-house 4-weekly payroll for over 2,000 hourly paid employees, while also managing weekly expenses, supporting pension administration and ensuring compliance with UK payroll legislation.

This is a varied and rewarding role where no two days are the same. You'll be the first point of contact for payroll and expenses queries, work closely with managers across the business, produce payroll reporting and help drive continuous improvements to our payroll processes. If you're highly organised, detail-focused and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

The successful Candidate will possess at least 2 years experience of processing end-to-end, in-house payroll, and they will have a strong understanding of UK Payroll legislation, pensions auto-enrolment and and statutory payments.
This role will require excellent attention to detail, strong communication skills and the ability to work at pace, but always with excellent accuracy.

Our Client is offering a Salary of 28,000 - 32,000 + Benefits.
